newsitem.title: UK: European cotton markets see prices dip on dollar.
newsitem.headline: European cotton markets see prices dip on dollar.

text.p: Prices for American types lost around 0.75 cents per lb on European cotton markets as the dollar softened against sterling and the mark.
Although this attracted greater buying interest it was not translated into firm trades, industry sources said.
Buyers are anticipating fresh falls in New York futures values, based partly on official U.S. production forecasts which are up 400,000 bales on the month.
Central Asian prices also took a 0.50 cent dip, helping to drive the 'A' Index down 0.40 points.
